purpose: Synthetic Quick Access fixture recipes and expected outcomes: exact-byte name mapping, Codes discovery, clipboard representability, partition isolation, and the performance corpus. Stores are generated at test time into a gitignored output directory; no ciphertext is committed here.
consumers: scripts/test.ps1 (materializes the synthetic store and fills fixtures/quick-access/test-evidence.template.md)
scripts/bench.ps1 (materializes the perf corpus and fills fixtures/quick-access/bench-evidence.template.md)
the Quick Access acceptance tests (broker protocol / core quick module) referenced by those scripts

store_parameters.note: Matches fixtures/stores/manifest.json so CLI/core cross-checks reuse one KDF cost.

name_rules.identity: exact raw name bytes plus physical slot; display strings are never identity

display_projection.split: ASCII slash 0x2F only; no filesystem normalization; dot segments and backslashes are data

root_rule.n1: one segment: item at the root of virtual vault 'Default (ungrouped)'
root_rule.n2: two segments: group = segment 0, item = segment 1, under 'Default (ungrouped)'
root_rule.n3plus: three or more segments: vault = segment 0, groups = middle segments, item = last segment, order preserved

display_projection.named_default: a literal first segment 'Default' renders as 'Default (named)'; the synthesized root renders as 'Default (ungrouped)'; both stay addressable

escaping.backslash: renders as two characters: backslash backslash
escaping.other_bytes: every byte outside 0x21..0x7E renders as \xNN (lowercase hex), including 0x7F..0xFF; literal marker text therefore cannot collide with the marker
escaping.empty_segment: renders as the marker U+2300 (EMPTY SET SIGN); a data segment containing those UTF-8 bytes renders as escapes
escaping.bidi_controls: bytes >= 0x80 are escaped, so RTL override bytes render as \xNN

display_projection.dual_nodes: a name that is both a stored item and a container prefix exposes two distinct actions (own value, browse children); never merge them
display_projection.duplicate_names: exact duplicate raw names (reachable via rename without a uniqueness check) are individually discoverable by slot; the core's first-match lookup shadows later ones, so mutation/copy-by-guess is disabled unless the target slot is unambiguous

projection_cases.name: Work/GitHub/key
projection_cases.notes: dual node; sibling P05b supplies children

projection_cases.name: GitHub/password
projection_cases.notes: same display label as P02 scenario; distinct internal roots; with P06a present both remain addressable

projection_cases.name: Work//GitHub/token
projection_cases.notes: empty segment preserved with the U+2300 display marker

projection_cases.name: /lead/x
projection_cases.notes: leading slash: the empty first segment is the vault, rendered with the U+2300 marker

projection_cases.name: trail/
projection_cases.notes: trailing slash: empty leaf segment preserved

projection_cases.name: a/./b
projection_cases.notes: dot segment is data; no normalization

projection_cases.name: a\b
projection_cases.notes: backslash is data inside a single segment; displays escaped as a\b

projection_cases.name: Work/<0xFF>/x
projection_cases.notes: non-UTF-8 byte 0xFF inside a segment renders as \xff

projection_cases.name: (255 x 'a')
projection_cases.notes: maximum-length name (255 bytes); value bound 473 - 255 = 218 bytes; a 256-byte name must be rejected with InvalidName

projection_cases.name: DELETED:old
projection_cases.notes: hidden from normal results; the slot stays eligible for tombstone reuse

projection_cases.name: b1
projection_cases.notes: invisible in P_A sessions at any generation

codes_cases.name: totp32/GitHub
codes_cases.notes: exact component 'totp32' anywhere in the path selects base32-first decoding (upstream s_totp32 quirks: stops at NUL/=/LF, rejects lowercase and digits 0/1/8/9)

codes_cases.name: Work/topt/GitHub/alex
codes_cases.notes: 'topt' display alias (raw TOTP by default, consistent with 'totp'); never passed blindly to the core totp_for matcher; explicit supported import metadata may select base32

codes_cases.name: totp-notes
codes_cases.notes: a label containing 'totp' does not by itself enter the Codes list; an explicit per-item code request still follows the CLI's historical substring conventions (core totp_for)

codes_cases.name: mytotpkey
codes_cases.notes: documented divergence: CLI `show` renders a code (substring match); the Codes auto-index requires an exact component

codes_cases.name: test
codes_cases.notes: plain password record; the Ctrl+Enter code action is disabled

code_expectations.invalid_seed: display 'Code unavailable'; the seed is never the fallback copy result
code_expectations.expiry_display: 30 at rollover, 1 in the final second; the countdown runs only while the Codes view is visible and unlocked
code_expectations.seed_handling: seed bytes never leave the broker; only the derived six digits reach the clipboard

clipboard_cases.notes: interior NUL: not text; typed error 0x109 ValueNotText; nothing published
invalid UTF-8: not text; typed error 0x109 ValueNotText; nothing published
TTL = min(30 s, remaining code window)

identity_cases.notes: exact duplicate raw names created by rename without a uniqueness check: both slots stay individually discoverable by slot ID; core first-match lookup returns the lower slot; copy/mutation by name alone is disabled when ambiguous
open/list/search/copy leave the store byte-identical (sha256 before == after)
a mutation under P_A preserves every P_B record byte-for-byte at its slot; verified by hash of the decrypted entries
maximum name length 255 bytes and value bound 473 - name_len are accepted at the boundary and rejected one byte over
stale item IDs (previous session generation) are rejected with 0x102/15 before any sensitive operation

recipe.names: 9500 x 'perf/group-<g:02d>/item-<i:05d>' (250 groups), 250 x duplicate leaf names 'perf/dup/<a..>/token', 250 x deep paths 'perf/deep/<d>/<d>/.../token' (12 segments)
recipe.value: short synthetic text; stores contain synthetic data only
recipe.generation: scripts/bench.ps1 materializes this corpus into a gitignored store before measurement

perf_corpus.requirements: include identical leaf names and deeply nested paths; measure after indexing is complete; keep cold launch, unlock/KDF, and warm summon as separate measurements

compatibility.cross_checks: round-trip this manifest's stores through the existing CLI (wsecret list/show/dump) and the core library; byte-exact dump equality is the oracle; opening/listing/searching/copying must leave the file unchanged
compatibility.partition_isolation: records of the other passphrase remain byte-preserved and readable after any mutation
compatibility.unexecuted_note: all rows here are planned expectations; results only count when recorded in a filled evidence file
